title: Product source ledger check report
description: Wrapper report for the vendored chaojifeng-video-design product_ledger.py. sourceHash is the SHA-256 of the ledger file that was checked (the ledger's own source of truth), not a reference video. The upstream ledger JSON itself keeps its native snake_case shape and is not re-shaped here. ok/errors/warnings/issues mirror the upstream `check --json` contract; null means not measured (blocked), never a default pass.

python.description: Python executable that ran, or null when unavailable.

ledger.description: The checked ledger file record; null when it could not be read.

ok.description: Upstream check verdict: true when the ledger closes with zero errors. Null when blocked.

reason.description: Blocked reason (PYTHON_MISSING, LEDGER_UNREADABLE, PROCESS_FAILED); null when complete.
